name: Sentai Soldier (CR 9)
body:
SENTAI SOLDIER
CR 9

XP 6,400
Tiefling vigilante 10 (sentai soldier)
CG (social identity) / NG (vigilante identity)
Medium outsider (native)
Init +4; Senses Perception +17; Darkvision 60 ft.

DEFENSE

AC 25, touch 15, flat-footed 21 (+6 armor, +1 deflection, +4 Dex, +2 natural, +2 shield)
hp 68 (10d8+20)
Fort +6, Ref +12, Will +9
Resist 5 fire

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk kukri +12/+7 (1d4/18-20) or kinetic blade +11/+6 (5d6+2)
Ranged kinetic blast +11 (5d6+2)
Special Attacks burning power (+2 att/dmg), negative blast 5d6+2

TACTICS

Before Combat If the Sentai Soldier can prepare for a fight, he’ll often prepare by accepting 1 point of burn to enhance his attack, using his Stealth skill to hide and enter his vigilante identity before attempting to snipe with his darkness infusion, gathering energy and empowering their blast if they think they can defeat their foe with the attack.

During Combat Once engaged in combat, the Sentai Soldier will use his battle charge to use his kinetic blade, empowering it until they have accepted 3 points of burn, saving the last point for a desperate situation. If he’s reduced to 10 or lower hit points, the Sentai Soldier will attempt to escape combat and use a potion of cure moderate wounds, leaving until he is better prepared to continue the fight.

Morale The Sentai Soldier won’t surrender until reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, but if he is knocked unconscious and not killed, he will negotiate with their foe unless threatened with torture, otherwise fighting to the death.

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 18, Con 14, Int 18, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Attack +7,; CMB +7,; CMD 20
Feats Extra Wild Talent (kinetic blade), Genius Vigilante, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +20, Bluff +0, Diplomacy +14, Disable Device +20, Disguise +14 (+34 vs having their identity discovered), Knowledge (local) +20, Perception +17, Sense Motive +17, Stealth +22, Survival +17, Use Magic Device +14
Languages Common, Dwarven, Draconic, Goblin, Infernal, Orc
SQ burn (4/day), elemental focus (void), infusions (darkness infusion, kinetic blade), internal charge (2 burn), light from the darkness (alternate racial trait), morphing transformation, powerful transformation, prehensile tail (alternate racial trait), scaled skin (alternate racial trait), seamless guise, social talents (celebrity perks, great renown, loyal aid, quick change, renown), utility wild talents (basic chaokinesis), vigilante talents (battle charge, empowered blaster, infusion specialist)
Gear potion of cure moderate wounds (3); Other Gear amulet of natural armor +1, +1 breastplate, +1 buckler, cloak of resistance +1, headband of vast intelligence +2, masterwork kukri, ring of protection +1, 397 gp
